name: find-contact
description: Finds a HubSpot contact (a person in the CRM) by email address, or searches contacts by name or company. An email is an exact lookup; a name scans up to maxPages pages of 100 contacts and answers up to 10 matches, with complete: false when more remained. Its ids feed hubspot__get-record, hubspot__update-record, hubspot__add-note and hubspot__create-task.

query.description: An email address or a name to find.

maxPages.description: How many pages of 100 contacts a name search scans. Defaults to 5.
